title: I am building a new RPG
author: Robiety101
selftext: For AI use, I pick different models depending on the specific Goal.  If you see something in the video you are particularly curious about feel free to ask.

comments.author: forrestwear
comments.body:
If you guys would spend more than a few days on making this stuff it might be impressive, but all i see is garbage after garbage after garbage. 

you guys are abusing the tools in the stupidest of ways. all the posts here showcasing 'games' are the equivalent of all the knock off handhelds that came packaged with bootleg emulators and roms no one has ever heard of.   
  
and the moment anything showcases anything cool or special or ''groundbreaking'' some slob repurposes it using claude or deepseek and wants to start charging money for it.   
  
spend more time making your game look real.. that is the magic. that is impressive part. that is worth building. not 20 flash games in 1 and calling it a role playing game

replies.author: Robiety101
replies.body: I've noticed a tend on aIgamedev that the better a game looks the more hate it will get from the Anti-AI crowd, so I appreciate the support.

replies.author: VitorinoVitorio
replies.body: yes, its true. But is a game bro.

replies.author: reverendblueball
replies.body:
This isn't aimed at the OP here, but I agree with your post. That's what I've noticed with vibecoding/aigemdev.

Your post is tough love, but it's very necessary. That's what's been bothering me about these tools. The games tend to be cool in the MVP/demo phase, but most don't have the appeal beyond fascination with the apps being used to make them. Many of the games posted here seem to come from something above boredom: "just because you could doesn't mean you should."

replies.author: Robiety101
replies.body:
It's not necessary to tell people not to make games they enjoy making.

It's probably necessary for people to stop being so angry that other people are enjoying themselves.

replies.author: forrestwear
replies.body: I saw your comment before you deleted it-- let me clarify a few things. 1) i don't hate a.i. i love that tools exist to advance game development. 2) it was not a personal attack on what you love or enjoy doing. i'm telling you to spend more time working on your passion project so it looks good. currently it looks terrible and unappealing. functional, yes. different, maybe? rpg? not even close.

replies.author: Robiety101
replies.body:
Yea, negative people will be negative no matter what, the content of the posts don't have much to do with it.  

There's lots of good, constructive feedback I'm sure my app could use that would be helpful, but it has nothing to do with the content, they are just upset and want to lash out at strangers online.

replies.author: Robiety101
replies.body:
Thank you! 

Yes, all the games have items that you collect which collectively go towards your inventory which you then use to trade for Items for your habitat. 

  
It is all connected.

replies.author: Robiety101
replies.body: All the games have items that you collect which collectively go towards your inventory which you then use to trade for Items for your habitat.  It's all connected to form the larger RPG.

comments.author: Infinitecontextlabs
comments.body: Is this based off the new movie coming out called Wildwood?

replies.author: Robiety101
replies.body: I had not heard of that movie. The forest is just one portion of the game where the animals hang out.  Probably will change the name of that sector at some point.

replies.author: Robiety101
replies.body: I wrote the lyrics and then inputted them into Suno which generates the song (you can select genres etc..)

replies.author: Robiety101
replies.body: The games are connected. The items the user collects in different games are all part of the same inventory.
